name: Inventory - Hardware summary
description: Short hardware report (model, serial, BIOS, CPU, RAM, disks with media type, TPM and OS build); inventory action that changes nothing and exits 0.

name: Inventory - Installed software
description: Lists machine-wide installed programs from the Uninstall registry keys (name, version, publisher, install date); as a check with -NameFilter it exits 1 when nothing matches, otherwise 0.

name: Inventory - Logged-on users
description: Lists interactive and remote desktop sessions (user, state, idle time, logon time) and the console user; inventory action that changes nothing and exits 0, also when nobody is logged on.

name: Inventory - Microsoft Office
description: Reports Microsoft Office Click-to-Run version, update channel, products and update settings plus MSI editions, never license keys; inventory action that changes nothing, exits 0, or 3 when Office is not installed.

name: Inventory - Monitors
description: Lists connected monitors from EDID (manufacturer, model, serial number, year, connection type, size); inventory action that changes nothing, exits 0, or 3 when no monitor is reported.

name: Inventory - Printers
description: Lists machine printers (driver, port, shared, local/network/virtual, status) and the Print Spooler state; inventory action that changes nothing, exits 0, or 3 when the Print Spooler service is absent.

name: Inventory - Startup programs
description: Lists auto-start entries (HKLM and loaded user Run/RunOnce keys, Startup folders, logon scheduled tasks) as location, name and command; inventory action that changes nothing and exits 0.

name: Inventory - Uptime and pending reboot
description: Reports last boot, uptime and pending reboot reasons; check exits 2 when a reboot is pending or uptime exceeds -MaxUptimeDays, otherwise 0.

name: Inventory - User profiles
description: Lists local user profiles (account, last use, loaded, folder size within a time budget) and flags stale ones; inventory that deletes nothing and exits 0, or as a check with -WarnOnStale exits 2 when a profile is unused for more than -StaleDays.

name: Inventory - Windows activation
description: Checks the Windows license status, channel and last 5 characters of the product key; check exits 0 licensed, 2 grace or notification, 1 unlicensed.

name: Hardware - Battery health
description: Checks laptop battery wear (full charge vs design capacity) and cycle count from WMI, no report files; check exits 2 when wear is over -MaxWearPercent, 3 when there is no battery, 0 otherwise.

name: Hardware - Disk health
description: Checks every physical disk (health status, temperature, wear, uncorrected errors, power-on hours); check exits 1 unhealthy or uncorrected errors, 2 warning or over the temperature/wear limits, 3 no physical disk info, 0 healthy.

name: Cleanup - Browser cache
description: Action that reports (dry run by default) or deletes the Chrome, Edge and Firefox disk cache of every user, never touching cookies, history, passwords or extensions; exits 0, or 1 on an unexpected error.

name: Cleanup - Clear temporary files
description: Reports (default dry run) or deletes with -DryRun:$false temp files older than -OlderThanDays in Windows, user, Windows Update and error reporting folders, optionally the recycle bin; action that exits 0, or 1 on error.

name: Cleanup - Disk free space
description: Checks free space on local fixed drives; check exits 1 when a drive is below both -MinFreePercent and -MinFreeGB, 2 when below one of them, 3 when -Drive does not exist, otherwise 0.

name: Maintenance - Clear print queue
description: Action that lists print jobs per printer and, with -DryRun:$false, stops the Spooler, deletes the spool files and always starts it again (optionally only when a job is stuck); exits 0 OK, 1 on failure, 3 when the Spooler is absent.

name: Maintenance - System file repair
description: Check (DISM ScanHealth and sfc /verifyonly) or, with -Repair, action (DISM RestoreHealth and sfc /scannow) for Windows system file corruption, never rebooting; exits 0 healthy or repaired, 2 corruption found or reboot needed, 1 not repaired or error.

name: Maintenance - Time synchronization
description: Check of the Windows Time service, time source, last sync and clock offset (one NTP sample), optionally forcing a resync with -Resync; exits 1 when the offset exceeds the maximum or the service is stopped, 2 when the last sync is older than 7 days, 3 when W32Time is absent, 0 otherwise.

name: Troubleshooting - Crashes and unexpected shutdowns
description: Check of blue screens (bug check codes), unexpected shutdowns and minidumps of the last days plus the top crashing applications; exits 1 when incidents reach -FailCount, 2 when they reach -WarnCount, 0 otherwise.

name: Troubleshooting - Event log errors
description: Check that groups critical and error events of the System and Application logs in the last hours by source and event id (top 15); exits 2 when errors are found, 1 on critical events with -FailOnCritical, 0 when clean.

name: Windows Update - Health check
description: Check of the local Windows Update client (services, last successful scan and install, SoftwareDistribution size, pending reboot, WSUS policy yes/no); exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL, 2 WARN.

name: Windows Update - Last install age
description: Check of the days since the last successful update install (definition updates ignored), optionally counting pending updates with -IncludePending (slow); exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL over MaxDays, 2 WARN over 75% of MaxDays.

name: Windows Update - Reset components
description: Action that stops the update services, renames SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 to a dated backup (keeping only the newest) and starts the services again; dry run by default, pass -DryRun:$false to apply.

name: BitLocker - Recovery key backup
description: Check that the OS volume has a BitLocker recovery password and that its backup to AD DS or Entra ID is recorded in the event log, never printing the key; exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL no recovery password, 2 WARN no backup evidence, 3 not applicable.

name: BitLocker - TPM and Secure Boot
description: Check of TPM 2.0 readiness, firmware type and Secure Boot; exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL no ready TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot off on UEFI, 2 WARN legacy BIOS with TPM 2.0, 3 legacy BIOS without TPM.

name: BitLocker - Volume status
description: Check of BitLocker on every fixed volume (protection, conversion, method, protector types, never keys); exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL when the OS volume is unprotected, 2 WARN for data volumes or encryption in progress, 3 not available.

name: Defender - Protection status
description: Check of Microsoft Defender service, antivirus, real-time and tamper protection, running mode and signature age; exit 0 OK, 1 FAIL protection off, 2 WARN stale signatures or tamper protection off, 3 Defender not available.

name: Defender - Recent detections
description: Check that lists recent Microsoft Defender detections (time, threat, severity, status, truncated path); exit 0 none or all remediated, 1 not readable, 2 active detection, 3 Defender not available.

name: Defender - Update and scan
description: Action that updates Microsoft Defender signatures and runs a quick or full scan, reporting versions and new detections; raise the timeout to 3600 for a full scan; exit 0 OK, 1 scan failed or threat not remediated, 2 update failed or threats remediated, 3 not available.

name: Network - Listening ports
description: Lists listening TCP (and optionally UDP) ports with owning process and services; as a check, exits 1 when a port given in -AlertOnPort listens on a non-loopback address, else 0.

name: Network - Reset network stack
description: Action that flushes the DNS cache and optionally resets Winsock and TCP/IP, defaulting to a dry run and rebooting only with -AllowReboot; exits 2 when a reboot is still required, 1 on error.

name: Network - Test connectivity
description: Check of active adapters, gateway ping, DNS resolution and a TCP connection with latency; exits 1 on no adapter, DNS or TCP failure, 2 when the gateway does not answer ping, 0 otherwise.

name: Network - Wi-Fi status
description: Check of the Wi-Fi connection (SSID, BSSID, radio type, band, channel, signal and link rates, never saved keys); exits 2 when the signal is below -MinSignal, 1 when the adapter is not connected, 3 without Wi-Fi, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Browser extensions
description: Lists Chrome, Edge and Firefox extensions of every user profile (browser, user, name, id, version); as a check, exits 1 when an id in -BlockList is installed, else 0.

name: Security - Domain and Entra join
description: Check of the Active Directory and Microsoft Entra join state (dsregcmd and CIM) with the domain secure channel test; exits 1 when the secure channel is broken or the join given in -Require is missing, else 0.

name: Security - Expiring certificates
description: Check of machine certificates (LocalMachine My, optionally WebHosting and Remote Desktop) close to expiry, ignoring renewed and long-expired ones; exits 1 within -FailDays or expired, 2 within -WarnDays, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Failed logons
description: Check of failed logons (event 4625) and lockouts (4740) in the last hours, grouped by account, source address, logon type and reason; exits 1 at -FailThreshold, 2 at -WarnThreshold, 3 when the Security log is not readable, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Firewall profiles
description: Check of the Windows Firewall Domain, Private and Public profiles; exits 1 when a profile is disabled, 2 when inbound default is Allow or a disabled profile is covered by a third-party firewall, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Hardening baseline
description: Check that scores 12 hardening controls (UAC, LSA protection, Credential Guard, WDigest, LLMNR, NetBIOS, AutoRun, SMB signing, PowerShell 2.0, Guest, Remote Registry, script block logging) with one PASS/FAIL line each; exits 1 when the score is below -MinScorePercent, 2 when any control fails, 0 when all pass.

name: Security - Local accounts
description: Check of local user accounts (enabled, last logon, password age and flags, Administrators membership); exits 1 when an enabled account does not require a password, 2 for never-expiring, old or inactive enabled accounts, 3 on a domain controller, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Local administrators
description: Lists members of the local Administrators group (found by SID, any language) with type and source; as a check with -Allowed, exits 1 when a member matches no allowed pattern, else 0.

name: Security - RDP security
description: Check of Remote Desktop settings (NLA, security layer, port, firewall profiles); exits 3 when RDP is disabled, 1 when enabled without NLA, 2 when open on the Public profile or using legacy RDP encryption, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - SMBv1 disabled
description: Check that SMBv1 is disabled; exits 1 when the SMBv1 server is enabled or its state cannot be read, 2 when only the SMBv1 client is enabled, 0 otherwise.

name: Security - Suspicious scheduled tasks
description: Check of non-Microsoft scheduled tasks running unsigned programs from user-writable paths, encoded or downloading PowerShell, hidden windows or mshta/rundll32/regsvr32 with URLs; exits 2 when a suspicious task is found, 1 on error, 0 otherwise.

name: Services - Service running
description: Checks that the services named in -Name are running, optionally starting them with -Restart; check exits 0 all running, 1 any not running, 3 service does not exist.
